text: Condensed mathematics (Clausen-Scholze) is relevant to HoTT research because:
choices: condensed sets provide a possible cohesive site for modelling cohesive HoTT with better analysis properties
explanation: Condensed sets (sheaves on the category of profinite sets) have excellent properties for analysis. They are proposed as a foundation for 'analytic geometry', and may provide models for differential/cohesive HoTT.
